name: room_monitoring_presets
create_sql:
CREATE TABLE room_monitoring_presets (
	preset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	room_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scheme VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	primary_source_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	channels JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (preset_id), 
	CONSTRAINT room_monitoring_preset_version UNIQUE (room_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES business_rooms (room_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
